record.field: Prepare your Yiwu market visit with sourcing support, local business services, transport, accommodation and practical city information.

Make the visit serve the purchasing decision

Start with the product categories, specifications, target quantity and decisions you need to complete in Yiwu. The plan can then connect market visits, supplier meetings, sample review and follow-up work.
Organize market visits by product category, evidence to collect and the suppliers that deserve follow-up.

Prepare before entering the market

List product categories, target specifications, quantity range, customization needs and destination requirements. This prevents a large market from becoming an unstructured browsing trip.

Capture comparable supplier information

Record booth identity, product references, materials, minimum quantities, sample terms, indicative lead time and the next verification step in one format.

Move qualified options into the project

Market conversations are starting points. Supplier identity, capability, quotation scope and samples still need to be verified before a purchasing decision.
Local support for the working visit
Coordinate sourcing assistance, interpretation, supplier meetings, samples and post-visit follow-up.

Sourcing coordination

Translate the buyer brief into a visit plan, schedule relevant supplier conversations and keep each finding connected to the requirement.

Interpretation

Use interpretation for technical and commercial details, not only basic introductions. Confirm terminology, numbers and commitments in writing.

Samples and follow-up

Label samples and connect them to supplier, specification and quotation records so the work continues after the visit.
Choose relevant fairs, check current schedules and plan how leads will be qualified after each meeting.

Verify dates with the organizer

Event schedules and admission requirements change. Confirm them with the official organizer before booking travel.

Build a focused meeting list

Prioritize exhibitors by product fit, target market and the evidence needed for the next decision.

Follow up consistently

Record contacts, products, open questions, samples and quotation deadlines while the conversation is still fresh.
Plan the route and local transfers
Compare current rail, air and road connections through major gateway cities and leave time for local transfers.

Choose the gateway city

International visitors commonly connect through major Chinese cities before continuing to Yiwu. Compare total travel time, arrival hour and transfer risk.

Check live schedules

Train, flight and road information changes. Use official transport sources for current schedules, identity requirements and ticket rules.

Plan local movement

Group market areas and supplier meetings geographically, and keep contingency time between appointments.
Select accommodation by market access, meeting locations, transport and the services your team needs.

Location first

Choose a base that reduces travel between the market districts, supplier meetings and transport hubs in your actual itinerary.

Confirm business essentials

Check current guest policies, internet access, breakfast times, meeting space, invoice support and late-arrival arrangements directly with the hotel.

Keep options flexible

Use refundable or changeable arrangements when supplier schedules are not yet fixed.
Add practical dining, shopping and leisure options around the sourcing itinerary without disrupting the work plan.

Plan around the itinerary

Choose dining and leisure locations near the day’s final meeting or your hotel to avoid unnecessary transfers.

Confirm current information

Opening hours, reservations and local conditions change. Check before traveling and use reputable transport arrangements.

Respect the working objective

Keep supplier entertainment separate from product evaluation, quotation comparison and approval decisions.
Prepare halal dining, prayer and culturally appropriate arrangements as part of the business itinerary.

Confirm needs before arrival

Tell the local coordinator about dietary, prayer and scheduling requirements so suitable options can be checked in advance.

Verify current venues

Restaurant status, certification, opening hours and access can change. Confirm directly before relying on a listing.

Build respectful meeting plans

Allow appropriate time for religious observance and communicate dietary requirements clearly when arranging group meals.
